Photo Geometry arXiv Daily

New papers on camera models and calibration, multi-view geometry, pose estimation and 3D reconstruction from arXiv (cs.CV, cs.RO, cs.GR, eess.IV), organized into 20 research topics.

Research topics

  • Camera Calibration & IntrinsicsIntrinsic calibration, lens and radial distortion models, self- and auto-calibration, focal-length estimation and radiometric (photometric) camera calibration.300 papers 2020-10-08 to 2026-11-14
  • Extrinsic & Multi-Sensor CalibrationCamera extrinsics and the rigid transforms between cameras, LiDAR, radar and IMUs: target-based and targetless, hand-eye, spatiotemporal and multi-camera calibration.302 papers 2020-11-23 to 2026-11-19
  • Generalized & Non-Central Camera ModelsCameras modeled as sets of rays: generalized and non-central cameras, multi-camera rigs treated as one generalized camera, Plücker-line formulations, rolling-shutter, light-field/plenoptic and pushbroom models.177 papers 2005-03-29 to 2026-11-19
  • Omnidirectional, Fisheye & Panoramic ImagingCatadioptric, fisheye, 360-degree and spherical cameras, equirectangular and unified camera models, wide-angle imaging, panorama and image stitching.301 papers 2024-08-19 to 2026-11-20
  • Single-View & Projective GeometryVanishing points, horizon lines, Manhattan/Atlanta-world structure, single-view metrology, image rectification, line-segment and wireframe geometry.225 papers 2008-10-24 to 2026-11-05
  • Epipolar Geometry & Relative PoseTwo- and multi-view relations: epipolar constraints, essential and fundamental matrices, homographies, trifocal tensors and relative camera pose.300 papers 2022-07-24 to 2026-11-12
  • Minimal Solvers & Robust EstimationMinimal solvers and polynomial (Gröbner-basis, homotopy) methods, RANSAC and its variants, consensus maximization, M-estimators and outlier-robust geometric fitting.231 papers 2009-10-26 to 2026-11-16
  • Absolute Pose & Visual LocalizationPerspective-n-Point and absolute pose, camera localization and relocalization against maps, scene coordinate regression and absolute pose regression.301 papers 2024-01-19 to 2026-11-17
  • Feature Matching & CorrespondenceKeypoint detection and description, sparse, semi-dense and dense feature matching, and geometric correspondence estimation.302 papers 2024-08-23 to 2026-11-20
  • Structure from Motion & Bundle AdjustmentIncremental and global structure from motion, bundle adjustment, rotation, translation and motion averaging, and camera resectioning.300 papers 2019-12-23 to 2026-11-13
  • Feed-Forward 3D ReconstructionLearned geometry models that regress pointmaps, depth and cameras directly from images (DUSt3R-, MASt3R- and VGGT-style), including pose-free and unposed reconstruction.305 papers 2026-04-11 to 2026-11-19
  • Stereo & Multi-View StereoBinocular stereo and disparity estimation, stereo rectification, multi-view stereo, depth fusion and dense surface reconstruction.302 papers 2025-07-07 to 2026-11-20
  • SLAM & Visual OdometryVisual and visual-inertial odometry, monocular, stereo and RGB-D SLAM, loop closure and pose-graph optimization.308 papers 2026-04-15 to 2026-11-20
  • Optical Flow, Scene Flow & Ego-MotionDense 2D and 3D motion: optical flow, scene flow, point tracking, motion fields and camera ego-motion estimation.305 papers 2025-03-13 to 2026-11-20
  • Monocular Depth & Surface NormalsSingle-image relative and metric depth estimation, depth completion and surface-normal estimation.305 papers 2025-12-19 to 2026-11-20
  • Point Cloud RegistrationRigid alignment of 3D data: point-cloud and point-set registration, ICP variants, scan matching and image-to-point-cloud registration.302 papers 2024-08-21 to 2026-11-19
  • Photometric Stereo & Shape-from-XGeometry from light and optics: photometric stereo, shape from shading, polarization and (de)focus, structured light, fringe projection, time-of-flight and inverse rendering.302 papers 2024-02-09 to 2026-11-20
  • Neural Rendering & Novel View SynthesisRadiance fields (NeRF), 3D Gaussian Splatting, image-based rendering and novel-view synthesis.311 papers 2026-09-04 to 2026-11-20
  • Photogrammetry & Satellite GeometryAerial and close-range photogrammetry, aerial triangulation and bundle block adjustment, satellite stereo, rational polynomial camera models, orthorectification and digital surface models.300 papers 2019-05-22 to 2026-11-13
  • Geo-Localization & Place RecognitionVisual place recognition, image and camera geolocation, cross-view (ground-to-aerial and ground-to-satellite) localization and sun-position cues.302 papers 2025-06-19 to 2026-11-20
